# imsobadatnicknames Geomorph Collection

The built-in **Geomorph Collection** starter deck is the full geomorph module
set by [imsobadatnicknames](https://imsobadatnicknames.itch.io/geomorph-collection),
released under CC BY-SA 4.0.

The distribution copy is stored in Cloudflare R2, not bundled in the web
build. It is published at:

`starter-tile-decks/imsobad-geomorph-collection/`

The manifest contains all 60 geomorph tiles across the pack's three module
sizes — `5x5/`, `10x5/`, and `10x10/` (20 tiles each) — with each tile's
`category` set to its module size so the tile picker can filter by size.

When a user chooses **Add Geomorph Collection starter deck**, the app
fetches these objects once and imports them into the active local vault. All
later random draws use those vault files and work offline.

Unlike the CC0 Kenney pack, this license requires attribution and is
share-alike — the exact text is retained in [LICENSE.txt](./LICENSE.txt).
